provenance.source: real-host bug on Pi, OpenCode and Claude Code: after a template expanded, Tab did not move to the next <field> and what the user typed landed in front of the placeholder ('Review the auth patch<change> for ...'); a field session is a flow of cursor moves and typing, so these cases type and press keys as a person does
provenance.author: murmo

cases.note: The cursor lands on the first field and the first typed key replaces its placeholder; nothing is left in front of or behind what was typed.

draft.text: Review the auth patch for races.

cases.note: Tab puts the cursor on the next field, and typing there replaces its default; the extra Tab after the last field is consumed, so the host's own Tab (Pi's file picker) does not open in the middle of a template.

cases.note: The previous-field key (Shift+Tab by default, here the configured F2) returns to the filled field with the cursor after its text, so typing adds to it.
